title: EthenaPay Daily Boost: Rates Paid to Oct 8, 2026
headline: What EthenaPay's Daily Boost paid
name: EthenaPay Daily Boost review
description: EthenaPay's Daily Boost paid 0.5% on the first $5,000, or 1.5% for a 6% group, over a 4.5% base in early October. Wallets that never used the card got it too.
imageAlt: Scatter chart of the Boost 584 EthenaPay wallets with 100 USDe or more received for October 8, 2026, as a yearly rate before compounding, against each wallet's balance. Most sit on three lines from Ethena Pay's terms, 0.5% a year on the first $5,000, 1.5% on the whole balance and 1.5% on the first $100,000. The 59 wallets that never used the card sit on the same lines.
